body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Finite bit-circuit construction; no new kappa claim.

This package proposes replacing phase-B B[314:361], frame 521,
in the PR589 tuned R439 word with a 31-ADD circuit instead of
the original 47-ADD block.

The supplied certificate records:
- Complete local ADDs, including literal reverse cleanup:
  24,305 -> 24,273.
- Forward positive-prefix bound: 49,347 -> 41,191.
- Reverse positive-prefix bound: 1,113,070 -> 1,005,338.
- Local payload: 93 -> 92 bits.
- Unchanged paid rank mass: 5,129.

All ten new files are isolated under:
research/r439-block521-factor/

Exact experimental base:
f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631

Recorded assignment: bit-supplier track, OS-random seed 10.

No selected-frontier or upstream files are modified.
No unrestricted optimality claim is made.

## Validation

The AI-assisted research session reported successful execution
of the verifier and exact reproduction of the bounded search.
I uploaded the extracted patch files through the GitHub web UI;
I have not independently rerun these checks.

Reproduction command:

python3 -I -B research/r439-block521-factor/verify.py

Recorded expected output:

PASS_R439_BLOCK521_FACTOR gates=47->31 ADDs=24305->24273 columns=661 controls=7 rank_mass=5129 kappa=unchanged

The verifier checks source pins, integer-map equality,
all 4,096 Boolean block inputs, reverse-map domination,
literal cleanup, 661 dirty-input endpoint columns, frame paths,
the inherited H1-H5 interface, accounting, payload bounds,
and seven negative controls.

Search reproduction:

python3 -I -B research/r439-block521-factor/search.py --output /tmp/r439-block521.json
cmp /tmp/r439-block521.json research/r439-block521-factor/CANDIDATE.json

The recorded search comprises 12,000 trials.
It is not a proof that 31 gates is minimal.

## Unresolved obligations

No hosted-program rebuild, physical invoice, supplier-binding
update, outer-assembly validation, repository-wide suite,
C++ cohort checks, or Lean verification is claimed.

Inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape,
exact-recovery and analytic assumptions remain unresolved.
Finite replay is not formal verification of the full
multiplication theorem.

## Attribution and AI disclosure

Builds on eumemic's PR555 construction, DreamingOfClouds'
PR589 tuning, Dylan Crow's exporter lineage, the PR873
verifier pattern, and retained predecessor notices.

Substantial OpenAI AI assistance was used for search design,
implementation, verification, and writing, as disclosed in
README.md and NOTICE.md.

Submitted for maintainer review and independent reproduction.
title: Research construction: R439 frame-521 block, 47 to 31 ADDs (no new kappa)
